body_markdown:
Duplicate contacts and unlogged conversations are just two more things you don’t need on your to do list. The Quo JobTread integration keeps customer information aligned between both systems so your team always has the context they need. Here’s how it works:


##


**Automatically log all phone communication**


Easily stay up to date on every interaction with a client. The Quo JobTread integration logs phone calls, texts, call, text, and voicemail along with AI-generated call summaries under the specific customer in JobTread.


##


**Save time managing contacts**


See when an incoming call is from a saved contact and avoid duplicate contact records between your CRM and Quo. Quo’s JobTread integration includes a bidirectional contact sync so you can stay organized.


##


Click to call


Need to call a customer after reviewing a job in JobTread? Easily click to call from JobTread using your Quo number.


##


**Get started using the Quo JobTread integration**


For existing JobTread customers, set up takes just two minutes. Quo workspace owners or admins can[set up the Quo JobTread integration](https://support.quo.com/jobtread) from the Quo web or desktop app.
